About

Behind the lens.

Hi, I’m Akshat, a 19-year-old photographer, videographer and video editor.

Originally from Kolkata, I now live in Bangalore, where I’m pursuing my undergraduate degree.

I’m experienced in photography, videography and video editing — from the first frame to the final cut.
